TYPE workout

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):

        core_anti_flexion:
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 per side
        diastasis_screen:
          protocol_note "Self-screen using coded, safe palpation method; avoid Valsalva; stop if pain or doming occurs"
          steps:
            - "Lie on back with knees bent, one hand at midline to feel separation" 
            - "Instruct client to perform gentle abdominal bracing and draw-in while maintaining neutral spine"
            - "Have client lift head/shoulders 2–3 cm; palpate for dome or linea alba separation at 2.5–5 cm above/below navel"
            - "Record: presence of diastasis (yes/no), approximate width in finger-widths, symptoms"
            - "If separation >2 finger widths or notable doming, mark as caution and adjust loading"
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Acclimatisation Session B":

          walking 5 minutes

        core_anti_flexion:
